items.title: Pseudo-coherence is preserved by the derived tensor product
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the pseudo-coherence of a derived tensor product of two bounded above complexes in terms of the two individual bounds, and the proof is a 17-line argument that replaces both complexes by bounded complexes of finite free modules with the prescribed cohomology comparison maps and then studies the tensor product of those maps. It observes that the tensor product of the two comparison maps induces isomorphisms above the expected degree and a surjection in that degree, and it closes by referring to the spectral sequence of tors for the verification and citing the pseudo-coherence criterion for the second part. The construction of the two comparison maps is displayed; the spectral sequence step is left to the reader.
